title: Texas SandFest: A Certified Festival Platform

scenes.title: Visitor Home
scenes.narration: Texas SandFest now has one connected demonstration platform for visitors and festival operations. The public experience begins with the event, its mission, dates, location, and the most important visitor actions. Every scene in this walkthrough comes from the isolated 2027 board runtime, with no external messages, charges, or live provider calls.

scenes.title: Live Beach
scenes.narration: Live Beach turns the festival map into a living guide. Guests can see crowd conditions, performances, sculpture locations, short food lines, and Sandy's suggested route. For the board demonstration, weather, ferry, camera, and crowd signals are continuously refreshed local simulations, so weak venue internet cannot block the presentation.

scenes.title: Ticketing and Consent
scenes.narration: Ticketing exercises the real cart, policy, consent, payment-event, fulfillment, and revenue contracts through a local payment sandbox. Marketing and safety consent remain separate and unchecked by default. Live charging stays disabled until the board approves activation and the production Stripe account, prices, domains, and signed webhooks are connected.

scenes.title: Sculptors
scenes.narration: The sculptor experience connects a governed roster to the beach. Guests can filter divisions, tap a marker, meet the artist, read about the work, and see where to find it. Staff can preview a reviewed C S V, publish or hold the roster, and use the same structured records across the website, native app, maps, and event-day signage.

scenes.title: Passport and People's Choice
scenes.narration: The Sculpture Passport makes exploration participatory. Guests scan markers as they visit each work, complete the trail, and become eligible for a prize drawing. People's Choice voting sits beside it with a live tally and configurable eligibility. Presentation reset restores the exact baseline, so rehearsal never contaminates the next walkthrough.

scenes.title: Sponsor and Vendor Intake
scenes.narration: Sponsors and vendors move through current, server-published programs instead of hard-coded prices. Public forms capture consent, generate a private status link, and create the staff review work. Sponsor brand proof, vendor compliance, booth assignment, receivables, milestones, and partner preferences remain connected without exposing private workflow data.

scenes.title: Guest Services
scenes.narration: Guest Services closes the loop on accessibility, lost property, family support, vendor questions, and other visitor needs. A guest receives a private status view, while staff see an accountable case queue with priority, ownership, internal notes, and safe public updates. The visitor never sees the internal operations record.

scenes.title: Operations Command
scenes.narration: The dedicated Operations portal opens on a festival command summary. Eight workflow signals bring together partner readiness, work, revenue, Guest Services, field conditions, messages, key dates, and launch gates. Staff tools stay outside the visitor bundle and remain permission-aware, while the presentation session reconnects automatically.

scenes.title: Document Intake
scenes.narration: Board, policy, operations, finance, Eventeny, QuickBooks, and communications files enter one private review queue. The current demonstration proves the briefing deck can be ingested, extracted, routed into delegated work, downloaded with checksum-verified bytes, and kept outside the public surface. Production promotion remains review-gated.

scenes.title: Partner Operations
scenes.narration: Partner Operations connects sponsor and vendor applications, outreach, message approvals, brand delivery, compliance, receivables, and key dates. Transactional notices can traverse the local provider sandbox automatically, while prospect outreach and uncertain delivery outcomes remain review-first. Duplicate-send protection and audit evidence stay intact.

scenes.title: Incident and Delegation
scenes.narration: Incidents and delegated work share a governed operating loop. Staff can open an issue, assign a team or individual, track urgency and deadlines, send a private task link, and close the work with evidence. The same records support staff, volunteers, Guest Services, partner milestones, and the native iPhone workflow.

scenes.title: Certification and Activation
scenes.narration: The final screen separates what is certified now from what activates after board approval. Ten reset-safe journeys, Chromium and WebKit acceptance, the local provider sandboxes, and exact baseline restoration prove the product. Stripe, QuickBooks, live communications, weather, ferry, camera edge agents, identity, Turnstile, domains, and managed recovery remain explicit production gates.
